author: Competiflow
description: Competitor monitoring for AI agents: track rival pricing, docs and changelog changes with evidence.
name: Competiflow

prompts.name: weekly_briefing
prompts.title: Competitor briefing
prompts.description: Summarize what competitors changed in a workspace over a period, most important first.

arguments.name: workspace_id
arguments.description: Workspace id. Omit to pick from list_workspaces.

prompts.name: triage_changes
prompts.title: Triage changes
prompts.description: Walk the unreviewed change inbox and propose acknowledge or dismiss for each change.

arguments.name: workspace_id
arguments.description: Workspace id. Omit to pick from list_workspaces.

arguments.name: min_severity
arguments.description: info, low, medium, high, or critical (default medium)

prompts.name: track_competitor
prompts.title: Track a competitor
prompts.description: Add a competitor by URL, wait for discovery, and report which pages are monitored.

arguments.name: workspace_id
arguments.description: Workspace id. Omit to pick from list_workspaces.

resources.name: guide
resources.title: Competiflow agent guide
resources.description: How to use the Competiflow tools: the typical flow, async discovery, evidence, triage, and delete versus pause.

resources.name: workspace_digest
resources.title: Workspace digest
resources.description: 7-day digest of one workspace: changes needing review with why_it_matters, activity by competitor, and top opportunities.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List all your workspaces with competitor and monitor counts, needs_review_count, and the highest unreviewed severity. Start here to find a workspace_id. For one workspace's recent activity, use get_digest.

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.title: Create workspace
tools.description: Create a workspace for one product or market. Set product_url to your own product so why_it_matters explains each change relative to it. Returns 422 when your plan's workspace limit is reached. To rename or change an existing workspace, use update_workspace.

name.description: Workspace name, e.g. the product or market it covers

product_url.description: Your own product's URL (e.g. example.com). The server adds https:// when missing.

tools.name: update_workspace
tools.title: Update workspace
tools.description: Rename a workspace, set or clear its product_url, or pause/resume every monitor in it. Send only the fields to change; nothing is written if any field is invalid. Pausing keeps all history, so prefer it over delete_workspace. To pause one competitor, use update_competitor.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from list_workspaces or create_workspace

name.description: New workspace name. Cannot be blank.

product_url.description: Your own product's URL (e.g. example.com). Pass null to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged.

status.description: paused stops checks on every monitor in the workspace; active resumes them

tools.name: delete_workspace
tools.title: Delete workspace
tools.description: Permanently delete a workspace with all its competitors, monitors, snapshots, and changes. Cannot be undone. Returns 409 discovery_in_progress while a competitor is still being discovered. To stop checks and keep history, use update_workspace with status paused.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from list_workspaces or create_workspace

tools.name: add_competitor
tools.title: Add competitor
tools.description: Add a competitor to a workspace by homepage URL and start discovering its pricing, docs, blog, and changelog pages. Discovery is async: poll get_competitor until discovery_status is completed. Re-adding the same URL returns the existing competitor. Returns 409 with active_competitor_id while another discovery runs in the workspace. To watch one specific page, use create_monitor.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from list_workspaces or create_workspace

monitor_types.description: Only discover these page types. Omit to discover all of them.

tools.name: list_competitors
tools.title: List competitors
tools.description: List the competitors in a workspace with discovery_status and their monitors, each with last_run. Use it for an overview of what is tracked. To list monitors alone or filter them by competitor, use list_monitors.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from list_workspaces or create_workspace

tools.name: get_competitor
tools.title: Get competitor
tools.description: Get one competitor with its monitors and discovery fields. Use it to poll discovery after add_competitor until discovery_status is completed or failed.

competitor_id.description: Competitor id from list_competitors or add_competitor

tools.name: update_competitor
tools.title: Update competitor
tools.description: Set the check cadence or pause/resume every monitor of one competitor. History is kept. To change a single monitor, use update_monitor; for a whole workspace, use update_workspace.

competitor_id.description: Competitor id from list_competitors or add_competitor

cadence.description: Check frequency. Faster cadences use more monthly checks; plans set a minimum (422 cadence_not_allowed).

status.description: active runs checks; paused stops checks and keeps history

tools.name: delete_competitor
tools.title: Delete competitor
tools.description: Permanently delete a competitor with its monitors, snapshots, and changes. Cannot be undone. To stop checks and keep history, use update_competitor with status paused.

competitor_id.description: Competitor id from list_competitors or add_competitor

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.title: List monitors
tools.description: List the monitors in a workspace, optionally for one competitor, with URL, type, cadence, status, health, and last_run. Use it to find a monitor_id or spot failing monitors. For competitors with their monitors nested, use list_competitors.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from list_workspaces or create_workspace

tools.name: get_monitor
tools.title: Get monitor
tools.description: Get one monitor's settings, health, and last run. Set include to also return the latest successful capture as structured data or markdown.

monitor_id.description: Monitor id from list_monitors or list_competitors

include.description: Evidence to add: capture (structured page data), capture_markdown (page as markdown), raw_diff

tools.name: create_monitor
tools.title: Create monitor
tools.description: Watch one specific page of an existing competitor, such as a pricing or docs URL that discovery missed. To add a new competitor and discover its pages automatically, use add_competitor.

competitor_id.description: Competitor id from list_competitors or add_competitor

url.description: Full URL of the page to watch

monitor_type.description: Kind of page: homepage, blog, docs, changelog, or pricing

cadence.description: Check frequency. Faster cadences use more monthly checks; plans set a minimum (422 cadence_not_allowed).

tools.name: update_monitor
tools.title: Update monitor
tools.description: Change one monitor's URL, type, cadence, status, or min_severity. Use status paused to stop checks and keep history. To change every monitor of a competitor at once, use update_competitor.

monitor_id.description: Monitor id from list_monitors or list_competitors

monitor_type.description: Kind of page: homepage, blog, docs, changelog, or pricing

cadence.description: Check frequency. Faster cadences use more monthly checks; plans set a minimum (422 cadence_not_allowed).

status.description: active runs checks; paused stops checks and keeps history

min_severity.description: Changes below this severity are not reported

tools.name: delete_monitor
tools.title: Delete monitor
tools.description: Permanently delete one monitor with its snapshots and changes. Cannot be undone. To stop checks and keep history, use update_monitor with status paused.

monitor_id.description: Monitor id from list_monitors or list_competitors

tools.name: check_monitor
tools.title: Check monitor now
tools.description: Queue an immediate check of one monitor. Uses one of your monthly checks and returns 429 refresh_throttled if the monitor was checked too recently. Results arrive asynchronously: read them later with list_changes or get_monitor. To check every monitor in a workspace, use refresh_workspace.

monitor_id.description: Monitor id from list_monitors or list_competitors

tools.name: refresh_workspace
tools.title: Refresh workspace
tools.description: Queue immediate checks for every active monitor in a workspace, or for one competitor when competitor_id is set. Each monitor checked uses one monthly check; recently checked monitors are skipped and listed in skipped_ids. Returns 409 while discovery is running. For a single monitor, use check_monitor.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from list_workspaces or create_workspace

tools.name: list_changes
tools.title: List changes
tools.description: List detected competitor changes in a workspace, newest first, with summary, severity, why_it_matters, monitor_type, and review_status. meta.counts gives inbox totals; page with after set to next_cursor. For a summarized period, use get_digest; for evidence on one change, use get_change.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from list_workspaces or create_workspace

review_status.description: unreviewed (in the inbox), acknowledged (seen and relevant), or dismissed (noise)

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, or a relative window: 1d, 7d, 30d

monitor_type.description: Kind of page: homepage, blog, docs, changelog, or pricing

tools.name: get_change
tools.title: Get change
tools.description: Get one change with why_it_matters, field-level diffs, and related clusters. Set include to add the captured page or the raw diff as evidence.

change_id.description: Change id from list_changes or get_digest

include.description: Evidence to add: capture (structured page data), capture_markdown (page as markdown), raw_diff

tools.name: update_change
tools.title: Triage change
tools.description: Triage a change by setting its review_status: acknowledged when it is relevant, dismissed when it is noise, or unreviewed to put it back in the inbox.

change_id.description: Change id from list_changes or get_digest

review_status.description: unreviewed (in the inbox), acknowledged (seen and relevant), or dismissed (noise)

tools.name: get_digest
tools.title: Get workspace digest
tools.description: Get a workspace summary for a period: changes needing review with why_it_matters, an activity map by competitor, and top opportunities. Use it for briefings; to page through individual changes, use list_changes.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from list_workspaces or create_workspace
